# assignmentB2iriscaglayan

assignmentB2iriscaglayan counts missing values in every column except the grouping column, grouped by a specified column.
It helps users summarize and compare missing data across groups.

## Installation

You can install version 0.1.0 of assignmentB2iriscaglayan from

```{r installation, eval=FALSE}
# Install if needed:
# install.packages("devtools")

devtools::install_github(
  "UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2iriscaglayan",
  ref = "0.1.0"
)
```

## Example
Count missing values in the `airquality` dataset grouped by month
```{r example}
library(assignmentB2iriscaglayan)
## basic example code
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```
